verdict.rationale: As merchant of record, Paddle's all-inclusive fee covers chargeback defense, so Paddle itself contests chargebacks rather than the finance-ops user. Payout reconciliation reports itemize chargeback fees, which gives only indirect visibility into dispute outcomes. Missing for 10: a merchant-facing way to submit structured dispute evidence, a dispute entity or status lifecycle (open/under review/won/lost) in the API or dashboard, dispute webhooks or notifications, and any independent corroboration of how chargeback defense works in practice.
